name: After § 49
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – annual report 2025
part_text: 49a. Underlines that the CFSP should be oriented towards economic cooperation, in particular with countries located along new transport routes such as the Middle Corridor, the India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC), and the New Development Road; underlines, in this regard, the strategic importance of strengthening EU relations with key partners, including the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, India, the United States, Georgia, Armenia, Azerbaijan and Türkiye, as essential actors in shaping global connectivity and trade flows; highlights that the EU should position itself as the intersection of these corridors, ensuring that Europe becomes the central hub for trade, energy and digital routes linking Asia, the Middle East, Africa and the transatlantic sphere;
